scope_allowed: Relevance of the quantities of interest

models.name: RANS–Porous-Media Bundle Model (RANS-PM)
models.what_it_computes: Whole-bundle blood and gas flow with anisotropic porous resistance; convective–diffusive transport of O2 and CO2 using effective properties and volumetric interfacial transfer terms to predict bundle-scale VO2, VCO2, outlet partial pressures, and segmental utilization.

models.name: Micro-Resolved Unit-Cell Conjugate Model (UC-CP)
models.what_it_computes: Resolved fiber geometry with coupled blood-side and gas-side transport; conjugate diffusion through the membrane, film mass transfer, and finite-rate hemoglobin/CO2 chemistry to predict local Sherwood numbers, fiber-level fluxes, and upscaled transfer coefficients.

mechanisms.name: Diffusion-limited O2 transfer at clinical flow and hematocrit
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Determines achievable arterialization and device sizing when blood-side film resistance dominates O2 uptake.

mechanisms.name: CO2 removal with bicarbonate chemistry and Haldane interaction
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Controls decarboxylation and acid–base management; kinetics can limit clearance even with adequate convection.

mechanisms.name: Bundle-scale blood-flow maldistribution
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Nonuniform perfusion underutilizes fiber area and lowers overall gas transfer despite adequate local kinetics.

mechanisms.name: Early fouling layer on fiber surfaces
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Protein deposition increases mass-transfer resistance over runtime, reducing VO2 and VCO2 under steady operating setpoints.

deviation.detail: Credibility factor scores are assigned on a 0–10 Credibility Index (integer values) with factor-specific decision rules.

expected_decision.outcome_source: Used together, the two models can give designers and clinicians higher confidence: the unit-cell model for physics fidelity and parameter grounding, and the bundle model for system-level predictions and trade studies.

findings.mechanism: Diffusion-limited O2 transfer at clinical flow and hematocrit
spans: When comparing the two finest bundle meshes, VO2 changes by 0.9% in oxygen-limited cases and VCO2 by 1.1% in carbon-dioxide-focused cases; pressure drop changes by 0.8%.

findings.mechanism: Diffusion-limited O2 transfer at clinical flow and hematocrit
spans: For the bundle model, steady-state runs use a pressure-based segregated scheme with algebraic multigrid pre-conditioners Nonlinear iterations continue until the maximum normalized residual in each equation falls below 1 × 108 and the change in VO2 over the last 300 iterations is less than 0.1%.
The species budgets are checked by integrating source terms and comparing against outlet minus inlet fluxes; budget imbalances are less than 0.3% across all reported runs.

findings.mechanism: CO2 removal with bicarbonate chemistry and Haldane interaction
spans: The coupon-scale program comprises six fiber–membrane coupons tested in a microfluidic channel for oxygen and four coupons tested for carbon dioxide transfer, with micro-PIV and microelectrode profiling to determine local boundary layers and interfacial fluxes.
The buffer composition for carbon dioxide tests includes 25 mM bicarbonate to emulate plasma; the oxygen tests use serum or plasma substitutes of matched viscosity.
